definitions.explanation: An intensifier emphasizing degree; often used before adjectives or nouns to indicate something is at an extreme or exceptional level.

examples.japanese: {極|ごく}⟦{少数|しょうすう}→少数：05611_shousuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Only a very small number of people know.

examples.japanese: {極|ごく}⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {極|ごく} is a formal intensifier that often emphasizes ordinary or extreme qualities.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {極|ごく}⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ (perfectly ordinary)
- {極|ごく}⟦{少数|しょうすう}→少数：05611_shousuu⟧ (very few)
- {極|ごく}⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧ (very recently)
- {極|ごく}⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧ (only a part)
- {極|ごく}⟦{稀|まれ}に→稀に：05728_mareni⟧ (very rarely)
- {極|ごく}⟦{自然|しぜん}に→自然に：27256_shizenni⟧ (very naturally)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {極|ごく} - quite, very (formal, limited usage)
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ - very (general, versatile)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}に→非常に：01223_hijouni⟧ - extremely (formal)

NOTE: {極|ごく} is typically used with certain fixed expressions and is less versatile than ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧.
